title: Mom's Venison Barbeque Sauce
description: In Mom's venison barbecue sauce recipe, seared venison steaks are roasted in a ketchup, mustard, brown sugar, and Worcestershire homemade barbecue sauce.
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).

Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion; cook and stir until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in ketchup, lemon juice, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, and yellow mustard until completely warmed.

Heat a separate skillet over medium-high heat. Season steaks with salt and black pepper; cook in the skillet until browned on each side, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer steaks to a 9x13-inch baking dish; pour ketchup mixture over steaks.
Bake in the preheated oven until steaks are cooked through and no longer pink in centers, about 1 hour.

Transfer steaks to a platter, shaking off any excess sauce back into the baking dish. Whisk water and cornstarch together in a small bowl until smooth; stir into hot sauce remaining in the baking dish until barbecue sauce begins to thicken. Pour sauce over steaks.
